result.explanation: Each submission owns the revision it creates and stores a pre-submit snapshot. Outcomes may settle their own pending record, but only the current owner at the same revision may alter fields. Edits and newer submissions therefore protect newer values.
result.mapping: The controller maps fields, revision, status, pending records, submission history, and current owner directly to the specified form state and causal guards.
result.assumptions: Inputs are valid JSON under the stated contract; field values are scalar JSON values and IDs are nonempty ASCII strings.
result.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!applies(input)||!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;var s=null;for(var i=0;i<input.events.length;i++){var x=solve({config:input.config,state:s,event:input.events[i]});if(JSON.stringify(x.output)!==JSON.stringify(output[i]))return false;s=x.state}return true}
